title: How much do you currently get paid?
content: "How much do you currently get paid?" I don't think you can lie about this question. It's easy to find out the truth. I would recommend saying exactly how much you made. "I was paid $50,000 a year plus an 8% bonus." "I received $27.50 an hour at my last position."

examples.sentence: How much do you currently get paid?
I was paid $50,000 a year plus an 8% bonus.
I received $27.50 an hour at my last position.
